main.description: Publish the group's website, whole: each file given is kept as a blob of the group's (one it holds already is used again), and the group's fyi.opensocial.site record is replaced by one naming them. Requires group.configure.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

files.description: Every file of the site, each at a path of its own.

notFound.description: The path of a file given, served with status 404 for a path no file has.

fallback.description: The path of a file given, served with status 200 for a page no file has, as a single-page app routes in the browser.

reads.description: The host's methods the site's pages may ask, as whoever is looking and signed in; none, and no writes, and the site is its files alone.

writes.description: The records the site's pages may write, as whoever is looking and signed in, in their own repo in the group's spaces.

errors.name: InvalidSite
errors.description: A site the host would not serve: a file at a path no file may be at, or at one another has; a file giving both its text and its bytes, or neither; a fallback or notFound that is none of the files; or a read that is none of the methods a site's pages may ask.

url.description: Where the site is served: the group's address, over https.

uploaded.description: How many of the files given were new to the group; the rest it held already.

file.description: One file of a site, its bytes given as text or as bytes.

path.description: Where it is served under the site's root: `/`-separated, with no leading `/`, no empty, `.` or `..` segment.

text.description: The file as UTF-8 text, as a page, a style sheet or a script is. Give this or `bytes`.

bytes.description: The file's bytes, as an image is: in JSON, as atproto writes bytes, `{"$bytes": "<base64>"}`. Give this or `text`.

contentType.description: The `Content-Type` it is served with; without it, the type its path's extension names.
